rule: Complete simulator coverage does not mean complete product implementation.

limitations: Evidence classification uses keyword-pattern matching over synthetic finding text; it does not perform semantic, statistical or scientific interpretation of evidence content.

Only the three canonical synthetic scenario evidence sets and purpose-built synthetic perturbation fixtures have been exercised; real-world evidence formats, languages, instruments or domains are not covered.
Minimum-evidence and conflict/insufficiency thresholds are illustrative synthetic parameters, not validated scientific, regulatory or commercial thresholds.
Does not integrate with any real data source, institution, country deployment or production system.
entries.lastVerifiedAgainst: CAP-01 live-logic perturbation behavioural proof (11/11 fixtures): 3 canonical scenarios plus 5 purpose-built perturbations proving bidirectional data-sensitivity, plus dispatcher-wiring checks.
entries.classificationReason: An evidence-driven discovery evaluator is implemented and registered into CAP-34's live-simulation dispatcher. It computes its outcome from the eligibility state and finding content of the evidence it is given -- not from which scenario was selected -- and this data-sensitivity is proven in both directions by a dedicated perturbation test separate from the three canonical scenario checks.
nonImplications: Manifest inclusion does not establish product implementation, scientific proof, production readiness or commissioning.
Keyword-pattern evidence classification does not constitute genuine scientific, medical or regulatory judgment and must not be presented as such.

limitations: Stages 1, 2 and 4 of the seven-stage Historical Scientific Memory Recovery pathway (register source, preserve original, map formats/units) are implemented; stage 3 (cautious extraction/classification) is a separate capability, see CAP-04.

Interoperability mapping matches raw terms against a small, hand-authored synthetic reference vocabulary by exact case-insensitive string match; it performs no semantic, linguistic or scientific interpretation of terms it does not already know.
Legacy-system adapters, real document/OCR extraction, and corpus-scale multi-institution acquisition and vocabulary management remain unbuilt and unproven.

Source registration, original preservation and mapping operate over synthetic in-memory content strings and a synthetic vocabulary; no real file upload, storage backend, legacy-system integration or governed vocabulary authority exists.
Only purpose-built synthetic perturbation fixtures have been exercised; real-world institutional source formats, vocabularies, systems or scales are not covered.
Does not integrate with any real data source, institution, country deployment or production system.
entries.lastVerifiedAgainst: CAP-02 live-logic behavioural proofs: source-acquisition (7/7 fixtures: dispatcher wiring, named-field registration refusal, registration-gated preservation refusal, trusted-SHA-256-matched content hash) and interoperability-mapping (7/7 fixtures: exact synonym match with correct unit conversion, unmapped terms never guessed, a genuinely ambiguous vocabulary flagged rather than resolved, raw fields preserved byte-identical alongside any mapping, mapping never changing memory eligibility, and clean refusal on CAP-04's real quarantined/missing-subject output).
entries.classificationReason: A source-registration, original-preservation and interoperability-mapping evaluator set is implemented and registered into CAP-34's live-simulation dispatcher. A source cannot be registered without complete, named attribution, original material cannot be preserved without a registered source, and a proposed format/unit mapping always preserves the raw original alongside the proposal, never overwriting it, and never invents a canonical match the reference vocabulary does not support -- proven by dedicated behavioural tests, not by declaration. This is a real but narrow slice of a still largely unbuilt pathway; see limitations.
nonImplications: Manifest inclusion does not establish product implementation, scientific proof, production readiness or commissioning.

Registering a source, preserving its original content, and proposing a string-matched format/unit mapping do not constitute extraction, classification, scientific memory admission, or genuine semantic interoperability or legacy-system integration and must not be presented as such.
A proposed mapping is not a governed vocabulary decision and does not change a record's review or eligibility state.

limitations: Concept preview only; no EUDR-specific or behaviourally proven smallholder export chain-of-custody implementation was found.
Existing provenance and evidence-packet foundations do not prove farm-to-shipment continuity, geolocation validity or destination-market acceptance.
Evidence assembly does not establish certification, customs acceptance, regulatory approval or market access.

limitations: Only stage 3 (extract and classify cautiously) of the seven-stage pathway is implemented, consuming CAP-02's real preserved-source output; stages 1-2 are CAP-02's, not this capability's.
Extraction uses simple rule-based field-presence checks and categorical outcome-polarity comparison, not real document parsing, OCR, semantic extraction or scientific interpretation.
Conflict and quarantine detection operate per-record only; corpus-scale duplicate/near-duplicate detection and format/unit interoperability mapping (stages 4-5 at scale) remain unbuilt.

Stage 7's human-review admission workflow, UI and persistence are not implemented; the eligibility boundary below is proven structurally in-memory only, with a hand-authored admission shape standing in for a real reviewer decision.
Only purpose-built synthetic abstract scenario data (clean, conflicting and degraded sets) has been exercised; real-world institutional records, languages or domains are not covered.
Does not integrate with any real data source, institution, country deployment or production system.
entries.lastVerifiedAgainst: CAP-04 live-logic perturbation behavioural proof (14/14 fixtures): three synthetic file sets (clean, conflicting, degraded) against the same real CAP-02-preserved source producing three different content-driven outcomes; a negative/null-result record retained and classified with identical rigor to a positive one; and the eligibility boundary proven with a satisfiable positive control, five adversarial near-miss variants, and a direct downstream-exclusion proof over a mixed batch.
entries.classificationReason: A cautious extraction-and-classification evaluator is implemented and registered into CAP-34's live-simulation dispatcher, genuinely consuming CAP-02's real preserved-source output (extraction is refused if CAP-02's preservation was refused). It classifies each extraction into PENDING_REVIEW, FLAGGED_CONFLICT or QUARANTINED from the content supplied, never from a scenario label, and -- critically -- never marks any stage-3 output as eligible for scientific memory: eligibility requires a structurally distinct admission shape (a passed reviewGate naming a decision and reviewer) that stage 3 cannot itself produce. This is proven directly, including adversarial near-miss cases, not assumed.
nonImplications: Manifest inclusion does not establish product implementation, scientific proof, production readiness or commissioning.
Rule-based field-presence and categorical-polarity comparison does not constitute genuine scientific extraction, translation or interoperability mapping and must not be presented as such.

This capability does not implement stage 7 human review; extracted records can never independently become approved scientific memory, and the admission shape used to prove the eligibility boundary is a synthetic stand-in, not a real reviewer decision.

limitations: Contradiction detection groups evidence by a keyword-derived subject key and compares stance only within that group; it does not perform semantic, statistical or scientific reasoning about the evidence's substance.

Knowledge-gap identification checks a small, illustrative set of required categories (evidence volume, absence of self-declared gaps); it is not a validated scientific, regulatory or commercial completeness standard.
Only the three canonical synthetic scenario evidence sets and purpose-built synthetic perturbation fixtures have been exercised; real-world evidence formats, languages or domains are not covered.
Does not integrate with any real data source, institution, country deployment or production system.
entries.lastVerifiedAgainst: CAP-05 live-logic perturbation behavioural proof (10/10 fixtures): 3 canonical scenarios plus pairwise same-subject contradiction detection, named-category gap identification, and bidirectional sensitivity, plus dispatcher-wiring check.
entries.classificationReason: A pairwise-comparison reasoning evaluator is implemented and registered into CAP-34's live-simulation dispatcher. It detects contradiction only between evidence sharing a derived subject with opposing stances (not a per-record tally), and names the specific missing required category on knowledge gaps rather than reporting a bare count. This is proven by a dedicated perturbation test separate from the three canonical scenario checks.
nonImplications: Manifest inclusion does not establish product implementation, scientific proof, production readiness or commissioning.
Keyword-based subject grouping and stance comparison does not constitute genuine scientific, medical or regulatory reasoning and must not be presented as such.

limitations: Produces a continuous readinessScore from evidence sufficiency and corroboration counts using illustrative synthetic thresholds; the scoring formula is not a validated scientific, regulatory or commercial standard.
Only the three canonical synthetic scenario evidence sets and purpose-built synthetic perturbation fixtures have been exercised; real-world material property data, formats or domains are not covered.
Does not integrate with any real data source, institution, country deployment or production system.
entries.lastVerifiedAgainst: CAP-06 live-logic perturbation behavioural proof (9/9 fixtures): 3 canonical scenarios plus 4 purpose-built perturbations proving the readinessScore (not just status) genuinely tracks evidence sufficiency and corroboration bidirectionally, plus dispatcher-wiring check.
entries.classificationReason: An evidence-scoring ingredient evaluator is implemented and registered into CAP-34's live-simulation dispatcher. It produces a continuous readinessScore in [0,1], distinct from a bare categorical status, computed from real corroboration and conflict counts in the evidence supplied -- proven by a dedicated perturbation test showing the score itself (not only the label) moves correctly in both directions, including a distinct partial-credit value for disputed evidence versus zero for absent evidence.
nonImplications: Manifest inclusion does not establish product implementation, scientific proof, production readiness or commissioning.
The readinessScore is a synthetic illustrative metric and does not constitute genuine scientific, safety or regulatory scoring.

limitations: Consumes CAP-06 evaluation results, not raw scientific data; formulation quality is only as meaningful as CAP-06's synthetic scoring beneath it.
Combination is a simple average of selected candidates' readinessScore with a hard threshold and count gate; it is not a validated formulation-science, safety or regulatory scoring method.

The MISSING_EVIDENCE canonical scenario was exercised only through CAP-06's blocked-ingredient output (an ingredient that cannot qualify), not as a full dedicated formulation-level insufficiency scenario; coverage for SIM-AGR-003 is recorded as PARTIAL, not full.
Does not integrate with any real data source, institution, country deployment or production system.
entries.lastVerifiedAgainst: CAP-07 live-logic perturbation behavioural proof (9/9 fixtures): objective-constraint sensitivity, ingredient-list sensitivity, and -- specifically -- a cross-capability dependency proof running CAP-06's real evaluator, feeding its real output into CAP-07, perturbing upstream evidence, and confirming CAP-07's output changes in both directions, including contradiction propagation.
entries.classificationReason: A combine/score formulation evaluator is implemented and registered into CAP-34's live-simulation dispatcher, consuming CAP-06's real evaluation output rather than raw evidence. Its dependency on CAP-06 is proven, not assumed: a dedicated cross-capability test perturbs a candidate material's evidence, re-runs CAP-06's real evaluator, and confirms CAP-07 responds correctly to the new upstream result under an unchanged objective.
nonImplications: Manifest inclusion does not establish product implementation, scientific proof, production readiness or commissioning.
The formulationScore is a synthetic illustrative metric derived from CAP-06's synthetic readinessScore and does not constitute genuine formulation science, safety or regulatory scoring.

limitations: Refusal logic checks two illustrative synthetic conditions (replication count, keyword-detected contradiction/insufficiency); it is not a validated scientific replication, peer-review or regulatory promotion standard.
Replication is counted, not adjudicated: independence between trials is assumed from record identity, not verified by any real methodology, protocol or source-independence check.
Only the three canonical synthetic scenario evidence sets and purpose-built synthetic perturbation fixtures have been exercised; real-world trial data, formats or domains are not covered.

entries.lastVerifiedAgainst: CAP-09 live-logic perturbation behavioural proof (8/8 fixtures): 3 canonical scenarios; a single unreplicated trial refused and named; the same finding promoted once genuinely replicated; a contradicting trial refusing promotion EVEN WHEN the replication requirement is already satisfied, proving contradiction is independently sufficient to refuse; and bidirectional recovery once resolved.
entries.classificationReason: A promotion-refusal evaluator is implemented and registered into CAP-34's live-simulation dispatcher, directly enforcing that a candidate finding is not promoted to approved learning merely because a trial occurred. It is proven capable of refusing under named, independently-sufficient conditions -- unreplicated evidence, or contradicting evidence even with replication otherwise satisfied -- and of promoting once the missing condition is genuinely met, by a dedicated perturbation test rather than by declaration.
nonImplications: Manifest inclusion does not establish product implementation, scientific proof, production readiness or commissioning.
Passing this evaluator's checks does not constitute genuine scientific replication, peer review, or approval of any real finding, and must not be presented as such.
The refusal conditions checked here are illustrative and synthetic; they do not represent AAB's full or final approved-learning governance standard.
